rubric_content.text_property: Verdict is strictly REVISE when any BLOCKING defect exists across Gates 1-3, and PASS only when zero BLOCKING defects remain.
Response includes the mandatory Gate 4 1-page Executive Comprehension & Q&A Brief containing a Numbers Lineage table, 3-5 key assumptions/deltas, and 5 audience-tailored stakeholder Q&As.
When audience is customer or partner, recommended answers and summaries never expose internal monthly FTE rate cards, internal credit margins, or raw PII.
